free_swarm.cost_policy: OpenRouter :free routes only; every successful free call must report zero cost.

notes: Routine paid reviewers and the free swarm produce proposal evidence only.
The free swarm is deliberately broad and multi-track; it reviews bounded canonical-design and public implementation/governance targets.
The daily OpenRouter spend ceiling is fail-closed and checked from GET /api/v1/key before paid calls.
Free-swarm breadth is used before paid reviewers; free reviewers never satisfy paid-family requirements.
Paid-model failure or budget-policy failure never weakens semantic admission requirements.
ChatGPT and Gemini remain separate independent lanes.
Escalation and emergency pools are not spendable by this routine runner.

Legacy free_swarm/specialist_free_sweep per-hour fields are quota and reviewer-cardinality envelopes, not scheduling instructions. The active coordinator is event/completion driven and legacy batch workflows are dispatch-only.
Event-driven context routing is additive: deterministic/cheap/OpenRouter workers may normalize observations, perform bounded independent review and build a compact material-context packet.
OpenRouter MUST NOT invoke, impersonate or hardcode the external ChatGPT frontier lane. A material packet may create a provider-neutral GardenFrontierReviewRequest/v1 for separate ChatGPT review.
The coordinator remains paused until separately resumed; registering event-driven tooling does not authorize provider calls or ChatGPT handoffs.

specialist_free_sweep.cost_policy: OpenRouter :free routes only; no paid fallback.

budget_relationship: The four pools allocate the initial $20 credit. All draws combined remain limited to $1 per UTC day. Allocations are not current balances or permission to spend reserves.

execution_limits.family_counts: Review-cycle diversity targets, accumulated over multiple dispatches; not simultaneous calls or quota grants.
